description: Prove and measure with numbers from the user's Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, including numbers the user pastes. Use it instead of calculating by hand: it handles spelling variants, control groups and trends. Pick with mode: impact = Before and after fixes, against pages you did not touch. Needs pages[{url, before, after, changed, fix}]. ai_citations = AI citations before and after, per engine. Needs pages[{url, before, after, changed}]. ai_referrals = Visits from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and other assistants, from GA4. Needs rows[{source, sessions, landing_page, period, conversions, revenue}]. brand_split = Brand versus non-brand clicks and how each moved. Needs brand_terms, rows[{query, keyword, clicks, traffic, impressions, position}]. share_of_voice = Share of the clicks against competitors from rank rows. Needs your_domain, rows[{keyword, position, volume, domain, url, group}].

brand_terms.description: Brand and product names, and misspellings.

days.description: Length of each period in days.

fix_date.description: Date the fixes went live, YYYY-MM-DD.

fix_log_id.description: Optional fix log from log_fix: takes the fix date from it and saves the result per fix, with a rollback plan for fixes that did worse.

rows_before.description: Optional same rows from an earlier period.

source.description: Where the counts come from, for example Ahrefs Brand Radar.

watch_ids.description: Optional watch ids, to list what changed on each page and when.

name: measure
title: Measure results
